info.title: Green Pavlodar — V2 + municipal API
info.description: V2 workflow and municipal import/analysis/export routes. Municipal calculations use labelled expert estimates; LLM adapter is optional; unconfigured or failed providers are explicitly labelled as rules fallback. Server session required; X-Demo-User is ignored. Cookie is HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict; local HTTP only. Send X-CSRF-Token from login/me on writes. Mutation replay rechecks current rights.
